notes: Colorado State reviewed against its official 2026-2027 'Programs A-Z' table (catalog.colostate.edu/general-catalog/programsaz/), whose degree column links each major's page ('B.A.', 'B.S.'). Pages headed 'Major in X' are recorded by their heading at the bachelor's level the list links them with (award_link_major/v1; 20 of 60 records checked by hand against the table). Concentration rows ('B.A. Concentration', 'B.M. Concentration Option') are options of their majors and are not counted; 'Dual Degree B.S.' is counted. Records from pages the list does not link are not promoted.
Not promoted (off-list or not a degree program): ipeds-126818 Major in Dance, B.A.; ipeds-126818 Major in Dance, B.F.A..
